transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I guess things have just been hard lately. Most days I wake up and it just feels like there's this heavy, gray weight sitting on me. Even when I'm out working with the crew, or... or around my kids, I just can't shake it. It's just this low, hollow feeling. Like I'm just going through the motions.
How long have you been feeling this way?

A while. Um... I guess it's been over three years now. Maybe three years and a few months. Ever since they switched up our groundskeeping contracts at work. The schedule changed, and... the days just got a lot longer. It just sort of took over everything.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?
I don't know. Um... I haven't really noticed anything like that, I guess. I still do the same stuff I always do. I just... don't really think about it much.
Do you find that you feel tired or lack energy most days, even when you haven’t done much physically?

Yeah, I guess. Um... by midmorning, it feels like I've already worked a full day. Even if it's a Sunday and I slept in... I just drag. Loading up the tools, looking over the plans for the week, making dinner... it's all just heavy.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over the past few months?
No, not really. Um... I eat about the same, I think. Haven't really paid attention to my weight. My clothes still fit fine, so... yeah. No real changes.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty, maybe blaming yourself for things more than usual?
No, I... I don't think so. I don't really sit around thinking about that kind of stuff. Just... try to get the work done, you know? So, no... I haven't noticed anything like that.
Would you say that you feel depressed or down most of the time, even when there’s no clear reason for it?

Yeah, I guess so. It's... it's just most days, honestly. Wake up and there's just this... this gray weight, I guess. Even when I'm out with the guys on a job, or... or home with the kids. Just feels low. Hollow. Like I'm just going through the motions.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless most days?
No, I... I haven't noticed anything like that. I just do what I have to do. I don't think I'm moving any slower, and I'm not restless. Just... getting through the day.
Have you noticed that you're less active than usual, or that it takes you longer to get things done, even simple tasks?
No, I... I don't think so. I still get my work done. It might feel like a drag, but... I'm still doing it. So, no, not really.
Have you ever felt like life isn't worth living, or thought about hurting yourself?
No. I mean... no, I don't think about that. Just... tired, is all. But I don't... I wouldn't do anything like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping much more than usual?
No, my sleep is... about the same. I work outside all day, so I'm usually pretty beat by the time I get home. I sleep okay, I guess. Nothing different.
Have you noticed that your work or daily tasks feel slower or more effortful than before, even if you’re still getting them done?
I... I don't know. Like I said before, it's just work. You just do what you gotta do. I don't really track if it's slower or whatever. It's just... the same. You just get through the day.
Would you say that your mood has been down or depressed for most of the day, nearly every day, over the past few months?

Yeah... I guess so. It's... most days, yeah. I wake up and it's just... like this gray weight is already sitting on me. Even when I'm out working with the crew, or... around my kids. I just can't shake it. It's this low... hollow feeling. Like I'm just going through the motions.
Have you noticed any trouble thinking clearly, focusing, or making decisions lately, even with simple things?
No. I don't think so. I just... do my job. It doesn't take much thinking anyway, you just do what you're told. So... no, I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Would you say that your low mood has been present for most of the day, more days than not, for the past two years or longer?

Yeah... longer than two years. Probably... a little over three years now. Maybe three years and a few months. 

It started back when they changed the groundskeeping contract at work. They messed with our schedule... the longer days just kind of took over my life. So... yeah. It's been a while.
Looking back, would you say that there have been times when you didn’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, even for a few weeks or more?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I still do the same stuff I always do. Just... watch a game, have a beer after work. I haven't really noticed losing interest or anything. It's just... yeah. No.
